headline: The No. 1 Pick Is Still on the Bench. Fernando Mendoza's Moment Is Coming.
title: Fernando Mendoza Jersey: Raiders Rookie Still Waiting
subheadline: The Raiders are 3-4 and sticking with Kirk Cousins, which leaves the league's most-hyped rookie quarterback waiting for his first start.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Fernando Mendoza had a top-five rookie jersey after the draft, but the Raiders are sticking with Kirk Cousins. What fans should know about his timeline.
searchIntent: Fans searching for Mendoza or rookie jersey rankings want to know when he will play and how his popularity compares with other rookies.
body: The most famous rookie in the NFL has thrown eight regular-season passes.

Fernando Mendoza, the No. 1 overall pick in April's draft, is still waiting for his first start with the Las Vegas Raiders. Head coach Klint Kubiak made that clear this week. After a 35-21 home loss to the Los Angeles Rams dropped Las Vegas to 3-4, its fourth straight loss, Kubiak said Kirk Cousins remains the starter.
Kubiak told reporters there is no quarterback debate inside the building, according to CBS Sports. He said the team has a plan for Mendoza but no timeline, and he ruled out a change this week.
## Why fans are watching anyway

Mendoza arrived in Las Vegas with as much hype as any quarterback in recent years. He won the 2025 Heisman Trophy and led Indiana to its first national championship, a 27-21 win over Miami in January. He threw 41 touchdown passes and six interceptions in his final college season.

That résumé showed up in early merchandise numbers. In a Fanatics ranking of the best-selling rookie jerseys reported on May 3, Mendoza ranked fifth. Dallas Cowboys safety Caleb Downs ranked first. Our [top selling NFL jerseys](/top-selling-nfl-jerseys/) list tracks the league-wide leaders. That snapshot came days after the draft, and no updated rookie sales ranking has been published since.
His only regular-season action so far came late in a 45-17 loss to the New England Patriots. He completed six of eight passes for 48 yards.
## The case for Cousins, and the case for change

Kubiak's decision is not hard to explain. Cousins has 16 touchdown passes, five interceptions and 1,877 passing yards, which ranks third in the league, per CBS Sports. He threw for 295 yards and two touchdowns against the Rams.

The case for change is about the long run. A 3-4 team on a four-game skid has to weigh the value of a few more wins against the value of game snaps for a franchise quarterback. Sports Illustrated has already argued the Raiders should make the switch now.
## When the Fernando Mendoza era could begin

The Raiders visit the New York Jets on Sunday with Cousins under center. CBS Sports speculated that the Week 13 bye would be a logical point for a change, which would set up a first start at home against the Chargers in Week 14. That is a writer's projection, not a team plan. For now, Raiders fans can only wait for the day Mendoza takes the first snap.

subject: Cameron Boozer
headline: Cameron Boozer Is Already Doing Things Only Legends Did as Rookies
title: Cameron Boozer Jersey: Grizzlies Rookie Tops the Ladder
subheadline: The No. 3 pick leads the NBA's first rookie rankings after a week that put him beside Oscar Robertson and Elgin Baylor in the record book.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Cameron Boozer leads NBA.com's first Rookie Ladder after a historic week for the Grizzlies. How the No. 3 pick stacks up against the 2026 rookie class.
searchIntent: Fans hearing about Boozer for the first time want to know why he leads the rookie class and how he compares with Dybantsa and Peterson.
body: The NBA's top rookie after one week is not the No. 1 pick. It is the 19-year-old doing a little bit of everything in Memphis.

Cameron Boozer, the third overall pick in June's draft, sits atop NBA.com's first Kia Rookie Ladder of the season, published Oct. 28. Through the Memphis Grizzlies' 4-0 start, he is averaging 14.8 points, 10.5 rebounds and 4.8 assists.
## A historic first week for Cameron Boozer
The numbers are not just good for a rookie. Some of them are rare at any age.

In a win over the Golden State Warriors, Boozer had 25 points, 13 rebounds and six assists. At 19 years and 97 days old, he became the third-youngest player in NBA history to post at least 25 points, 10 rebounds and five assists in a game, according to NBA.com.

Earlier, in a win at Sacramento, he became the fifth player ever with at least 10 rebounds and four assists in each of his first three games, per ESPN. The other four are Ben Simmons, Oscar Robertson, Elgin Baylor and Maurice Stokes. He was a plus-36 over the four wins.
The 3-0 start was the franchise's best since 2017-18, per ESPN. Ty Jerome has carried much of the scoring, with 45, 28 and 31 points in the first three games. Boozer has filled every other column.
## How he compares with the rest of the rookie class

The 2026 class arrived with three headline names. No. 1 pick AJ Dybantsa missed the first week with a sprained left ankle and was set to debut for the Washington Wizards on Oct. 28. No. 2 pick Darryn Peterson is averaging 11.5 points for the Utah Jazz.

Others are scoring more than Boozer. Golden State's Yaxel Lendeborg is averaging 21.8 points and Chicago's Caleb Wilson 21.0. But Boozer is winning, rebounding and passing at the same time, which is why he leads the ladder.
## Is Boozer a jersey to watch?

No rookie jersey sales figures have been published for this season. Last year's No. 1 pick, [Cooper Flagg](/players/cooper-flagg/), reached ninth on the NBA's list as a rookie. Popularity among rookies usually follows the players fans see on highlight shows, and Boozer has given them plenty.
The early schedule will tell whether his rebounding holds up against bigger frontcourts. If it does, the rookie of the year race may already have a front-runner.

subject: Milwaukee Brewers
headline: The Brewers Are World Series Champions for the First Time
title: Milwaukee Brewers Jerseys After a First World Series Title
subheadline: Milwaukee beat Tampa Bay in five games behind Series MVP William Contreras and a pitching staff that allowed 2.4 runs per game.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: The Brewers beat the Rays in Game 5 to win the first World Series in franchise history. How William Contreras and a small-market roster finished the job.
searchIntent: Fans celebrating, or catching up on, the title want the story of the clincher and the players who defined it.
body: For 57 years, the Milwaukee Brewers were one of baseball's franchises still waiting. That wait ended Wednesday night in St. Petersburg.

Milwaukee beat the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5 on Oct. 28 to win the World Series four games to one. It is the first championship in Brewers history and Milwaukee's first MLB title since the Braves won in 1957, according to MLB Trade Rumors.
## William Contreras, World Series MVP

Catcher William Contreras was named Series MVP. He hit .381 with a .435 on-base percentage, four RBIs, two walks and a stolen base in the five games, according to Yahoo Sports, while running a pitching staff that held Tampa Bay to 2.4 runs per game.

The clincher belonged to the pitchers. Jacob Misiorowski threw 5 2/3 scoreless innings. Trevor Megill recorded the final out on a Richie Palacios groundout, finishing the postseason a perfect 5-for-5 in save chances. Left-hander Aaron Ashby was arguably the staff's most valuable arm, with 18 scoreless innings, 20 strikeouts and three saves, per MLB Trade Rumors.
## A champion built differently

The Brewers won an MLB-high 103 games, the first 100-win season in club history. They beat the San Diego Padres in the Division Series, swept the two-time defending champion Los Angeles Dodgers and [Shohei Ohtani](/players/shohei-ohtani/) in the NLCS and lost only two games all postseason.

They did it without a superstar payroll. Before the Series, coverage focused on the meeting of two small-market clubs, and Milwaukee is the lowest-payroll champion since the 2015 Kansas City Royals, according to the Series' Wikipedia entry.
## What the title means for Milwaukee Brewers jerseys

No Brewers player appeared on MLB's list of the 20 [most popular player jerseys](/top-selling-mlb-jerseys/) for the 2026 regular season, which covered sales through Sept. 27 and excluded the postseason. That list was dominated by the Dodgers, Yankees and other big-market stars.

A title tends to change that kind of picture. Contreras, Misiorowski, Jackson Chourio and rookie shortstop Cooper Pratt are now champions with national name recognition. Whether that shows up in sales will not be known until MLB publishes new data.
## What comes next
Milwaukee is planning a championship parade. Then comes an offseason in which a small-market champion has to decide how much of this roster it can keep together.

subject: Jacob Misiorowski
headline: Jacob Misiorowski's Historic Season Ended With a Ring
title: Jacob Misiorowski Jersey: Brewers Ace Caps a Historic Year
subheadline: The 24-year-old led the majors in ERA and strikeouts, set a record for opponents' average and closed out the World Series.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Jacob Misiorowski led MLB in ERA and strikeouts, then pitched the Brewers to a World Series title. Why the 24-year-old ace is a rising star to watch.
searchIntent: Fans who watched the clincher want to understand how rare Misiorowski's season was and whether he is the next star jersey in baseball.
body: Jacob Misiorowski spent the regular season putting up numbers nobody had seen in decades. In October he finished the job.

The 24-year-old Milwaukee Brewers right-hander threw 5 2/3 scoreless innings in Game 5 of the World Series on Oct. 28, a 4-1 win over the Tampa Bay Rays that clinched the first championship in franchise history. He also won Game 1, allowing one earned run over five innings.
## A historic regular season
Misiorowski's 2026 season belongs in the record book. He went 16-5, per Yahoo Sports, and led the majors with a 1.80 ERA, 252 strikeouts and a 0.80 WHIP over 174 2/3 innings, according to MLB.com.

Opponents hit .157 against him, the lowest mark on record for a full season. That broke the record of .167 set by Pedro Martínez in 2000. He joined Martínez and Justin Verlander (2019) as the only pitchers with 250 or more strikeouts and a WHIP of 0.80 or lower.

He also became the first pitcher since Mike Scott in 1986 to lead the majors in ERA, strikeouts and opponents' batting average. Sandy Koufax (1965) and J.R. Richard (1979) are the only others since 1950. He is the second Brewers pitcher to win an ERA title, after Corbin Burnes in 2021.
## From prospect to the face of a champion

Milwaukee entered the season without its longtime ace. The Brewers traded Freddy Peralta to the New York Mets in the offseason, and Misiorowski filled the gap. He led MLB in ERA and strikeouts at the All-Star break and made the NL All-Star team.
His October work added to the case. He started the opener and the clincher of the World Series, and the Brewers won both.
## Is the Jacob Misiorowski jersey next?

Misiorowski did not appear on MLB's list of the 20 [most popular player jerseys](/top-selling-mlb-jerseys/) for the 2026 regular season. No Brewers player did. That list covered sales through Sept. 27, before the postseason.

That makes him one of the most interesting jerseys to watch this winter. Only two full-time pitchers made that top 20: Yoshinobu Yamamoto at No. 9 and [Paul Skenes](/players/paul-skenes/) at No. 15. A young ace with a historic season and a World Series ring has the profile to join them. Until new sales data comes out, that remains a projection.
## What's next
Awards season arrives in November, and Misiorowski's numbers make him a strong candidate for the National League Cy Young Award.

subject: Connor Hellebuyck
headline: Connor Hellebuyck Got His Fresh Start. The Devils Got a Contender's Goalie.
title: Connor Hellebuyck Jersey: Vezina Winner Joins the Devils
subheadline: After a holdout and a trade from Winnipeg, the three-time Vezina winner won his New Jersey debut and gave the Devils a new kind of ceiling.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Connor Hellebuyck won his Devils debut after a months-long standoff in Winnipeg. What the trade means for New Jersey and the playoff question he has to answer.
searchIntent: Fans searching for Hellebuyck after the trade want the deal terms, how his debut went and what it means for the Devils.
body: The most decorated goalie of his generation is wearing a new jersey, and his debut came after a months-long standoff.

Connor Hellebuyck made 17 saves in his first game with the New Jersey Devils on Oct. 27, a 5-1 win at Dallas that ended the Stars' five-game winning streak. It was his first NHL game since he asked out of Winnipeg.
Hellebuyck said afterward that he had been ready to play for two months, according to NHL.com.
## How Connor Hellebuyck got to New Jersey

Hellebuyck spent his entire 11-year career with the Winnipeg Jets. He won the Vezina Trophy three times and the Hart Trophy as league MVP for 2024-25. In February he helped the United States win Olympic gold at the Milan-Cortina Games.

He requested a trade in September. The Jets suspended him when he did not report to training camp, and he went unpaid into the regular season, according to the Associated Press. The Jets finally traded him on Oct. 23. Winnipeg received forward Dawson Mercer, goalie Nico Daws, prospect Alexander Command, injured forward Nick Bjugstad, a 2029 second-round pick and a 2027 seventh-round pick.
Hellebuyck has five seasons left on his contract at an $8.5 million cap hit.
## A contender gets its missing piece

The Devils were already rolling. After the Dallas win they were 8-4-0, with four straight wins and six victories in their last seven games. Nico Hischier scored twice, and [Jack Hughes](/players/jack-hughes/) and Luke Hughes each had a goal and an assist.
Coach Sheldon Keefe called his new goalie outstanding after the game.

The trade gives New Jersey an elite goalie behind a young core that already draws fans. Jack Hughes ranked fourth on the NHL's [top-selling jersey list](/top-selling-nhl-jerseys/) for the 2025-26 regular season.
## The question that will define the Devils' season

Hellebuyck's regular-season numbers are not in doubt. He has a career record of 345-208-55. His playoff record is the open question. He is 15-26 in the postseason since 2018, with four first-round exits, according to the AP.

That is why this trade matters beyond October. New Jersey did not acquire Hellebuyck to win in the fall. The Devils traded for him to change how their spring ends. A new Devils jersey on a Vezina winner is a fresh story for fans, and the real verdict will come in April.

subject: Lionel Messi
headline: Lionel Messi Is Done With Argentina. He Is Not Done Making MLS History.
title: Lionel Messi Jersey: Golden Boot Race After Argentina Exit
subheadline: With two matches left, Messi leads the Golden Boot race by three goals and is in line to become the first three-time MLS MVP.
author: Top Selling Jerseys
description: Messi leads the MLS Golden Boot race with 25 goals and two games left after retiring from Argentina. What to watch as Inter Miami heads into Decision Day.
searchIntent: Fans following Messi's final weeks of the regular season want the Golden Boot math and what is left on Inter Miami's schedule.
body: [Lionel Messi](/players/lionel-messi/) has played his last game for Argentina. His MLS season is not done, and neither is his chase for more history.

Messi went scoreless on Oct. 28 as Inter Miami needed a 90th-minute goal from Riquelme Fillipi to draw FC Cincinnati 2-2. He still leads the MLS Golden Boot race with 25 goals, three ahead of FC Dallas striker Petar Musa, with two regular-season matches left.
## The first month after Argentina

Messi played his final international match in early October against Benin, scoring once and setting up two goals, according to MLSsoccer.com. Four days later, he scored twice in a 4-0 win over D.C. United at Nu Stadium.

The scoring has been steady all season. On Aug. 30 he scored four times in a 7-1 rout of CF Montréal, his first four-goal game in MLS, including two free kicks. Miami's seven goals set a franchise record.
He is now chasing two marks. A second straight Golden Boot is within reach. MLSsoccer.com also notes he is in position to become the first player to win MLS MVP three times.
## Still the most popular MLS player with fans

There is no question about Messi's place with fans. MLS's official ranking of the [best-selling jerseys](/top-selling-mls-jerseys/) of the 2025 regular season put him first. LAFC's Son Heung-min was second, and teammate Luis Suárez was fourth. The league has not yet published its 2026 list. Last year's list came out on Oct. 23, so a new one could arrive soon.
## What to watch on Decision Day
Miami is third in the Eastern Conference with 56 points, two behind New England, per WSVN. The two teams meet on Sunday at New England. Miami then hosts Charlotte FC on Nov. 7, Decision Day.

Musa and Dallas have two matches left as well. A three-goal lead is large but not safe, given that Messi himself has scored four in one match this year. The Golden Boot's first tiebreaker is assists, and Messi had 13 of those by mid-October, per MLSsoccer.com.

After Decision Day comes a postseason that begins with wild-card matches on Nov. 18 and ends with MLS Cup on Dec. 18. For a 39-year-old who has just stepped away from his national team, the club stage now has his full attention.

headline: Petar Musa Is the Only Striker Still Chasing Messi
title: Petar Musa Jersey: FC Dallas Striker Chasing Messi
subheadline: FC Dallas's Croatian forward has 22 goals and two matches to make up a three-goal gap, with the West's top seed also in play.

body: [Lionel Messi](/players/lionel-messi/) is not the only striker who can still win the 2026 MLS Golden Boot. The other one plays in Frisco, Texas.

Petar Musa has 22 goals for FC Dallas, second in the league and three behind Messi's 25, with two regular-season matches left. On Oct. 28 he had a chance to cut into that lead. He did not score as Dallas lost 2-0 at home to the Columbus Crew, and a Shaq Moore goal was ruled out after VAR found Musa offside.
## How Petar Musa became a Golden Boot contender

Musa, a Croatian striker, led the scoring race until Messi passed him with a four-goal game on Aug. 30. He has kept pace since, and only three players in the league have reached 19 goals, according to MLSsoccer.com's Golden Boot tracker. Philadelphia's Milan Iloski is third with 19.

His goals have carried Dallas into the postseason picture. The club clinched a playoff berth earlier this month with a win over Seattle, per NBC DFW. Even after the loss to Columbus, Dallas sits one point behind Vancouver for first place in the Western Conference, according to Big D Soccer.
## Why FC Dallas fans should care

FC Dallas has reached MLS Cup only once, losing to the Colorado Rapids in 2010. Dallas is currently a top-four seed in the West, which would bring home-field advantage in a best-of-three first-round series, per NBC DFW.

The Petar Musa jersey did not make MLS's list of the [best-selling jerseys](/top-selling-mls-jerseys/) of 2025, which was led by Messi and Son Heung-min. That list predates this season. A Golden Boot race against the most famous player in the world is the kind of storyline that gives a striker a national profile.
## What to watch in the final two matches

Dallas visits Sporting Kansas City on Saturday and then plays the Colorado Rapids. Musa needs three goals just to draw level with Messi, assuming Messi does not score again. Assists are the first tiebreaker.
The math is hard, and the West's top seed is still on the line. Either way, Musa has already shown that FC Dallas has a scorer who belongs among the most dangerous in MLS.
